pre_ingest_baseline.canonical_company_vs_nmls_vs_lei: Kept as distinct identity layers. A Colorado HMDA row is not a new organization. An MLO row is not a company.

clock_reconciliation.national_production_source: lender_hmda_observations geo_grain=county grouped by state_code, published in lender-network-metrics-v1 geography
clock_reconciliation.why: Canonical for /colorado is SUM(data/hmda/by-state/CO/county_market_summary.csv) over 64 county rows. That sum matches data/hmda/by-state/index.json CO applications and originations. The previously published network geography CO row (257,140 / 156,145 / 39,356) is the production lender_hmda_observations county-grain LEI aggregate, a different input from the by-state county market summary. Originations match across both. Applications and denials do not. Do not add the two. Do not rewrite the national county-grain total to force symmetry. Ask is not rewritten. County-grain is not added to state-grain.

hmda.source: Committed HMDA Colorado partition data/hmda/by-state/CO/county_market_summary.csv. Properties located in Colorado. Not a second national download.
hmda.caveat: HMDA is a mortgage-application filing extract for properties located in Colorado. It is not a Colorado mortgage-company registration roster, not an MLO license count, and the denial rate does not prove discrimination. An HMDA reporter is not a Colorado state-licensed mortgage company. Application != lender. Origination != lender. County-grain HMDA is not added to a second state-grain total on this page.

mlo_roster.source: Colorado Information Marketplace dataset 4zse-6bnw Licensed Real Estate Professionals in Colorado, filtered licenseprefix=MLO
mlo_roster.authority: Colorado Division of Real Estate / Board of Mortgage Loan Originators
mlo_roster.caveat: MLO rows are people, not lenders, not branches, and not additional national lender entities. They are not published as a person directory and are not claimable profiles. The license number is a Colorado DRE credential, not automatically an NMLS Individual ID. Absence from this roster does not mean a person is unauthorized: federally registered depository MLOs may be outside the state-licensed roster. State-license absence != unlicensed. casenumber is not proof of final discipline. Employer/entity strings are not used to mint companies.

live_roster.dre_note: DRE states mortgage-company license histories are at NMLS Consumer Access, not issued as a DRE certified-history file.
live_roster.caveat: Colorado mortgage companies register through NMLS subject to exemptions. No current public bulk company-registration roster was acquired. Search-only is not zero. Missing is not zero. Do not invent a Colorado lender census. NMLS Company ID is the expected public company identifier when a live search returns one. Do not build companies from MLO names or employer strings.

dre_enforcement.agency: Colorado Division of Real Estate / Board of Mortgage Loan Originators
dre_enforcement.grain: case / enforcement observation / final order remain separate when source-native
dre_enforcement.casenumber_field: Present on DRE professional rows; literal None is not a case.
dre_enforcement.caveat: Case != violation. Investigation != discipline. Complaint != enforcement. Allegation != finding. A DRE casenumber is not automatically a final adverse order. Name-only adverse attachment is UNSAFE.

complaints.caveat: The public DRE complaint process is not a complaint dataset. No bulk complaints acquired != 0 complaints. No attached complaint != clean history. Complaint != violation. Complaint != final action. CFPB mortgage complaints are a separate federal overlay and are not merged into DRE complaints.

cfpb.caveat: Complaint is not a violation. Raw complaint count is not a quality ranking and is not exposure-normalized. CFPB complaint != Colorado DRE complaint. No company complaint rate is published against an HMDA denominator.

programs.caveat: CHFA is not the mortgage licensing authority. Participation is not licensure, regulatory approval, a Trust rating, a quality rating, or an endorsement. CHFA states participating-lender search results do not constitute an endorsement or referral and do not guarantee service quality, outcomes, or results. No name-only attachment to canonical lenders.

depository.caveat: FDIC institution != Colorado mortgage-company registration. A bank may lend without being a state-registered mortgage company.

foreclosure.note: No dedicated statewide structured Colorado foreclosure file was acquired.

regulator_matrix.does_not_prove: A lender company, branch, NMLS Individual ID, or that absence means unlicensed

regulator_matrix.proves: Nothing numeric in this snapshot; bulk roster not acquired
regulator_matrix.does_not_prove: A complete Colorado lender census, FDIC identity, or endorsement

regulator_matrix.what: Nationwide Multistate Licensing System company identifier

regulator_matrix.proves: Nothing in this extract; field not present

regulator_matrix.what: Appears on a CHFA participating-lender / homebuyer path
regulator_matrix.proves: Program-participation listing as of page retrieval
regulator_matrix.does_not_prove: Licensure, endorsement, TrustHub recommendation, or quality
